description: Android repos that run Jupiter instrumented tests via de.mannodermaus.junit5. Only extend this if the repo actually uses that runner.

packageRules.description: Hold junit-bom on 5.x: the android-junit5 runner refuses to run Jupiter instrumented tests below API 35 on JUnit 6, which would drop on-device coverage for every device older than Android 15. Revisit when the device farm is all API 35+.
